description.value: Orchard Convenience is UBC Okanagan's campus convenience store, situated on the main floor of Nechako Residence steps from the Student Housing Desk. It stocks grab-and-go snacks, basic groceries, household essentials, hygiene products, and coffee, serving the campus community during the academic year. Cyclists passing through the UBCO campus would find it a handy stop for quick provisions, though it operates on a student-term schedule and closes each summer.

address.value: Nechako Residence Building, 1255 International Mews, Kelowna, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real UBCO campus convenience store located in Nechako Residence, 1255 International Mews, Kelowna, offering basic groceries, snacks, and coffee. The site explicitly states it is 'Closed for Holidays' with all days showing closed and a note indicating closure from Apr 25 – Sept 1, meaning it is seasonally shut during summer but not permanently closed. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Store is currently closed for summer holidays (website indicates closure Apr 25 – Sept 1); cyclists visiting outside the academic year will find it shut.
OSM name is 'Orchard Convenience Store' but the website consistently uses 'Orchard Convenience' (no 'Store').
No store-specific phone number found; OSM has no phone, and the website only lists a general UBCO Food Services number (250-807-9208).
OSM has no address; address was sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational campus convenience store with confirmed basic groceries; summer closure is seasonal, not permanent. Useful to cyclists transiting the UBCO campus.
